FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his advisors, a group of bespectacled men in fine robes.

KING (he) "My dear advisors, I have a vision. A vision of a new era for our great empire. An era of... of... (he consults a parchment)...of 'Vaporwave-ness'!"

ADVISOR 1 (he) "Vaporwave-ness, Your Majesty?"

KING (he) "Yes, yes! A fusion of the finest medieval aesthetics with the most avant-garde, futuristic sounds. We will call it... (he pauses dramatically)...Vaporwave- Medievalism!"

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, who are all staring at him in confusion.

ADVISOR 2 (he) "But, Your Majesty, what does this 'Vaporwave-ness' entail?"

KING (he) "Ah, my dear advisors, it means we will incorporate the most cutting-edge, avant-garde elements of vaporwave into our empire's aesthetic. We will use... (he consults a book)...of 'VHS tapes', 'cassette tapes', and 'CDs' as decorative elements. We will wear... (he gestures to his advisors)...of'sweatpants', 'hoodies', and'sneakers' to signify our commitment to this new era."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "But, Your Majesty, what about our traditional armor? Our banners? Our... (he gestures to the king's beard)...our magnificent beards?"

KING (he) "Ah, my dear advisors, those are all part of the 'Vaporwave-ness'! We will incorporate... (he consults a book)...of 'distressed textures', 'glitch art', and'VHS static' into our armor, banners, and beards. We will be the most... (he pauses dramatically)...the most 'Vaporwave- Medieval' empire in all the land!"

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now dressed in their new, Vaporwave-inspired attire. They are all wearing sweatpants, hoodies, and sneakers, and their armor is adorned with distressed textures, glitch art, and VHS static.

KING (he) addresses the crowd, a group of peasants and merchants who are all staring at him in confusion.

KING (he) "My dear subjects, I present to you... (he gestures to his advisors)...the new face of our empire! A face that is... (he pauses dramatically)...of 'Vaporwave-ness'!"

The crowd murmurs in confusion, but the king's advisors are all nodding enthusiastically.

ADVISOR 1 (he) "Yes, Your Majesty! We are the future of medievalism!"

ADVISOR 2 (he) "We will make our empire the most... (he consults a book)...the most 'Vaporwave- Medieval' empire in all the land!"

KING (he) "Then let us begin! Let us... (he gestures to his advisors)...let us 'Vaporwave-ize' our empire, once and for all!"

The camera zooms out as the king's advisors all nod in agreement, and the crowd begins to murmur in confusion.

FADE TO BLACK.
